Hydra design system · DS compliance audit · 29 Oct 2026 · Light mode

RSFC module files vs. Hydra Ant Design - DS

Read-only audit of the 7 RSFC module files: components, token binding, text styles by role, colour roles and spacing. 55 screens checked from node data, 57 findings (39 verified on screenshots). Nothing was changed in Figma. Reply “Fix approved” with finding IDs to start fixes.

Summary

One finding groups the same issue on one screen or one repeated layout (×N = number of layers). Severity: High wrong / detached component, unbound or non-Hydra colour; Medium wrong text style or role, unbound or off-scale spacing, outdated library; Low minor overrides and naming.

Verified – seen on a screenshot and confirmed in node data.
Inferred – same pattern found in node data only (or the node is clipped).
File-level – a library link problem reported once per file instead of per text layer.
Needs designer decision – the fix would move, recolour or reflow something by more than a snap.

Ranked by severity, reach (layers × screens) and how visible the drift is.

  1. ADMIN-LIB-001 High Admin – Text styles point at Hydra style keys that do not resolve in this file ×168

  3. BOM-001 High BOM – Action column cells are detached Table cells ×80
  4. RN-001 High Release Notes – "What's New" screen is a hand-built old ASC shell ×1

  7. ADMIN-RN-002 High Admin – "New release note" modal is hand-built ×1

Typography role table

From Documentation/ds-inventory.json (built 2026-10-29 from how Hydra components use the styles).

RoleHydra text styleEvidence
Page titleNot defined by the DSNo DS page-header component. Closest DS uses of a 24px title: Result title, Empty State Block title, Topbar logo text = Title/Heading 3. See hydra-ux-patterns.md for what modules use in practice.
Section headingTitle/Heading 4 (20/28)Cards page: 'Product Name' card heading = Title/Heading 4 (x2). Weak evidence; no DS section component.
Card / panel / modal / drawer titleTitle/Heading 5 (16/24)Modal title, Drawer title, ExportCard title, Sidebar product name, Topbar tagline all use Title/Heading 5.
BodyBase/Normal (14/22)Default text in Menu, Breadcrumb, Input, Select, Table cell, Modal body.
Secondary / descriptionBase/Normal + colorTextDescriptionModal/Alert/Steps/Result/Popconfirm description layers = Base/Normal; colour carries the role.
LabelBase/NormalInput 'Required' label, Stat Tile label = Base/Normal.
Table headerBase/MediumTable header cells = Base/Medium (x48).
Table cellBase/NormalTable cell text = Base/Normal (x192).
ButtonBase/Normal (middle) / Large/Normal (large)Button set: Base/Normal x25, Large/Normal x15.
Helper / captionSmall/Normal (12/20)Small Tag/Select sizes; card meta line 'Section ... | Page' = Small/Medium.
TagBase/Normal (default) / Small/Normal (small)Tag set: Base/Normal x36, Small/Normal x4.
Alert / notification titleLarge/Medium (Alert), Base/Medium (Popconfirm)Alert title = Large/Medium; Popconfirm title = Base/Medium.
Big number / KPITitle/Heading 3Stat Tile value and Statistic number = Title/Heading 3.
Active tabBase/Medium (middle) / Large/Medium (large)Tabs: Base/Normal x30 + Base/Medium x12.

ADMIN-LIB-001HighLibrary linkVerifiedFile-level×168

Text styles point at Hydra style keys that do not resolve in this file

Current

168 text layers in 11 sampled screens (Dashboard, Release Notes Admin, Knowledge Center) carry style IDs like S:ec6191…,1772:64 (Base/Medium key + local suffix). Figma cannot resolve them, so the layers show no style.

Expected

Every text layer linked to a published Hydra text style (Base/Normal, Base/Medium, Large/Normal …).

Proposed fix

Re-link the Hydra library in Admin (Libraries → swap / update), then re-apply the same style names. Also 3 layers on Lead Time still use the old name Large/Strong (now Large/Medium).

Open questions

  • Page title level

    Pages use Title/Heading 2 (Admin KC, CFM, Lead Time; BOM Export), Heading 3 (Content, BOM wizard) or Heading 4 (SPEC, BOM Hub, RN). The patterns doc recommends Heading 3. Confirm before titles are snapped; no finding was raised for this yet.

  • Description style

    SPEC and BOM Hub use Title/Heading 5 for page descriptions; the role table says Base/Normal + colorTextDescription. Confirm, since the fix changes 16 → 14 px (BOM-006, SPEC-006, ADMIN-CFM-001).

  • Selected-row tint (CON-004)

    Content rows use the removed primitive primary-bg-subtle (#F6FAFC). Should selected rows use controlItemBgActive (#EBF5FA, Ant default) or colorPrimaryBgSubtle (#F6FAFC, same look)?

  • Admin library link (ADMIN-LIB-001)

    Style IDs end in a local suffix (…,1772:64), which suggests the styles were copied in from another file. Who re-links the Hydra library in Admin, and is there a reason the file is not on the published library?

  • Unified Search root opacity

    Screen 3.5 — Create a new BOM Project (287:2332) has the whole frame at 20 % layer opacity (node data only). Intended presentation state or a leftover?

  • Guidance cards (USEARCH-004)

    Which Hydra card replaces the foreign "card" component: OptionCard (type action) or FeatureCard?

  • Modal width standard

    Hand-built Admin note modal is 672 wide; DS modals in the modules are 538–720. One standard form width is needed before ADMIN-RN-002 can be rebuilt.

  • colorIcon value

    The AI contract says colorIcon is 45 % black; the variable resolves to 100 % black in Light (carried over from the inventory).

Method

  • Started from the 48 UI screens of today's PATTERNS run (ledger in the scratchpad) and added under-covered screens: Content Submittal and BOM variants, Part Search Add to Submittal / Add to BOM / STEP download, Unified Search 3.3 and 3.4. The Global Notifications flow diagram (65:1010) was excluded.
  • Every visible node outside DS instances was walked with figma_execute (figma-console Desktop Bridge, each file addressed by fileKey). Checked: instance source (Hydra component and icon keys vs. local / other library), detached look-alikes by name and structure, fills / strokes / radius / effects / opacity binding, text style and text colour, padding and gaps against the Ant scale.
  • Screenshots are crops exported with exportAsync and embedded; 37 were reviewed visually. Findings without a usable crop are marked Inferred.
  • BOM: the bridge held this time; all 12 BOM screens were read in full (3 batches). No access problems in any file.

Skipped

  • Cover, Change Log, Archive, Working / WIP sections, hidden layers, flow diagrams, annotation frames, icon vectors and image internals, layers inside DS instances (only instance-level overrides were checked).
  • Admin "To design" placeholder pages (Access Blacklist, Companies, Users, Roles, Feature Access Limit) – no real screens.
  • Content File Manager was audited read-only (no BOM work was done, so AGENTS.md is not affected).
  • "Needs update" status of library instances cannot be read through the plugin API; outdated libraries were detected by old style and variable names instead (PS-LIB-001, USEARCH-LIB-001).
  • Spacing values were treated as on-scale for 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 48. Unbound on-scale values are grouped per screen, not listed one by one.
